title: Quenched Peruvian Chicken Roast
description: Tender and indulgent Peruvian dish featuring kaffir-lime-leaf with an al-dente finish. Shojin-friendly pollo a la brasa recipe.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, paprika, garlic, oregano, coriander, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the sliced ají amarillo peppers to the pot and sauté for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Add the chicken broth and soy sauce to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the chicken to the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Baste the chicken with the pan sauce every 20 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with chopped kaffir-lime leaves and serve hot.
